The '''South Beach''' was the southernmost [[Beach/Legends|beach]] on an [[Unidentified island (Lehon)|island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]].<ref name="KOTOR" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the beach hosted the [[Elder Rakatan Settlement|settlement]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] tribe known as the [[Elders (Rakatan)|Elders]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
